blocks.text: Skeletal muscle ke cells, yani muscle fibres (myofibres), guchhon (bundles) ki shakal mein hote hain jo collagen fibres aur connective tissue mein lipte hote hain. Skeletal muscle ke siron par yahi collagen aur connective tissue tendons banate hain, jo muscle ko haddiyon se jorte hain.

Har skeletal muscle cell, yani muscle fibre, ek lamba (cylindrical) cell hai jis mein bohat se nuclei hote hain. Is ke gird plasma membrane hoti hai jise sarcolemma kehte hain (Fig. 12.20). Is ke cytoplasm ko sarcoplasm kehte hain, aur is mein sarcoplasmic reticulum (SR) hota hai. Sarcolemma cell ke andar gehrai tak ja kar khokhli lambi naliyan banati hai jinhen transverse tubules (T-tubules) kehte hain. T-tubules SR ke siron tak pohanchti hain.

Har muscle fibre mein saikron se hazaron lambe dhaage jaise hisson ka guchha hota hai jinhen myofibrils kehte hain. Myofibrils do qism ke filaments se bani hain: mote (thick) filaments jo myosin protein ke bane hain, aur patle (thin) filaments jo actin protein ke bane hain. Mote filaments gehri pattiyan (dark bands) banate hain jinhen A-bands kehte hain, aur patle filaments halki pattiyan (light bands) banate hain jinhen I-bands kehte hain. Yahi baari baari gehri aur halki pattiyan skeletal muscle ko dhaari dar (striated) banati hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke har muscle fibre mein 4 se 20 myofibrils hote hain. Asal mein aik skeletal muscle fibre mein saikron se hazaron lambe, dhaage jaise myofibrils hote hain jo us ki poori lambai mein chalte hain aur cell ki taqreeban 80% jagah bhar dete hain.

Patle actin filaments protein ki discs se jure hote hain jinhen Z-lines kehte hain. Do Z-lines ke beech ka hissa sarcomere kehlata hai; yeh muscle ke sukarne ki sab se chhoti ikai (unit) hai. Sarcomere mein patle filaments Z-line se beech ki taraf barhte hain aur wahan mote filaments ke saath ek doosre par chadh jate hain (overlap). Yeh overlap A-band banata hai; A-band ke beech ek halka hissa H-band hai jahan overlap nahin hota (Fig. 12.20).

blocks.title: Khulasa
blocks.text:
Skeletal muscle ki tarteeb mukhtasar mein:
• Skeletal muscle cells ke guchhon se bana hai jinhen muscle fibres kehte hain.
• Har muscle fibre ke cytoplasm mein myofibrils ke guchhe hain.
• Har myofibril do qism ke myofilaments (myosin aur actin) se bani hai.

blocks.alt: Skeletal patha jo tendon se haddi se jura hai; sire par muscle fibres ka kata hua guchha (bundle). Ek muscle fibre (ek cell) daen ko mura hai; us ke kate sire mein sarcolemma ke neeche sarcoplasmic reticulum mein lipte myofibrils hain. Pattiyon wala myofibril baen neeche ko mura hai, sarcomere nishan zada, aur sire se actin aur myosin myofilaments nikalte hain; box wala hissa bara kar ke H zone, I band, A band, Z line, myosin aur actin dikhaye gaye. Inset: sarcolemma T-tubules banata hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bare se chhote ki taraf chalein: patha, phir reshon ka guchha, phir ek resha (cell), phir myofibril, phir sarcomere, phir filaments. Sarcomere mein A band mote myosin ki lambai hai, I band sirf patle actin ka hissa, aur H zone beech ka woh hissa jahan sirf myosin hai. Do Z lines ke darmiyan ek sarcomere hai.

Muscle ke sukarne ke waqt patle filaments A-band mein mazeed andar phisal jate hain, jis se H-band aur I-band tang ho jate hain. A-bands ek doosre ke qareeb kheench liye jate hain aur muscle chhota ho jata hai. H-band ke beech ek gehri lakeer ho sakti hai jise M line kehte hain; yeh mote filaments ko apni jagah thame rakhti hai.

Mote myofilaments taqreeban 16 nm (nanometre) mote hote hain aur bohat se myosin proteins se bane hain. Har myosin protein do aapas mein lipti (intertwined) polypeptide chains se bana hai jo ek gol “sar” (head) par khatam hoti hain. Yeh myosin heads mote filaments se bahar nikle hote hain aur muscle ke sukarne ke waqt actin se jurte hain (Fig. 12.21).

blocks.alt: Upar: myosin filament jis ke dono hisson se bohat se heads nikle hain. Teer ek myosin molecule tak jata hai: do guthi hui polypeptides jo do heads par khatam hoti hain. Neeche: actin filament jo actin ke daanon ki do bal khayi ladiyon ka hai, us ke saath lipte tropomyosin ke dhaage aur barabar faslon par troponin. blocks.caption: Figure 12.21: Myofilaments ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 12.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Patle myofilaments 7-8 nm mote hote hain aur teen proteins se bane hain: (i) in ka beech ka hissa (core) actin ki do bal khayi lariyon (strands) se bana hai. (ii) Tropomyosin ki do lariyan actin ke gird lipat kar use sakht karti hain. Dheele muscle fibre mein yeh actin par myosin ke jurne ki jagahen (binding sites) dhaanp kar rakhti hain. (iii) Troponin protein patle filaments par thore thore fasle par hota hai. Yeh teen polypeptides se bana hai: ek polypeptide rokne wala (inhibitory) hai aur actin se jurta hai; doosra tropomyosin se jur kar use apni jagah thame rakhta hai; teesra calcium ions se jurta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Mota filament bohat se myosin molecules ka bana hai; har molecule ke heads hi baad mein actin ko pakar kar cross-bridges banate hain. Patle filament mein tropomyosin dheele pathe mein actin par myosin ke jurne ki jaghein dhanp deta hai, aur troponin us ko apni jagah thame rakhta hai jab tak calcium na aaye.
